rules.name: xoga713-view-deployed-check
rules.sql: SELECT c.relkind AS kind, (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%underlying_settle_value_table%')::int AS live_formula, (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%asset_class%')::int AS equity_filter, (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%curr_mult_table%')::int AS old_stored_table, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname = 'helper_var_mult_factor_view'

expect.reason: it is a view, not a table
the view reads underlying_settle_value_table (live formula, v2)
equity and equity swaps are excluded, as in legacy
it no longer reads the stored curr_mult_table (Nihal's v1)
